task.title: Add the Flake Ledger and Quarantine Policy

metrics.coverageNote: This task implements verification-ledger policy and CI topology; runtime coverage was not re-measured, so null is reported rather than a fabricated percentage.

tdd.red: scripts/verification/flake-ledger.test.ts was written before production code and failed because ./flake-ledger did not exist. After the model was implemented, 9 tests passed and the CI scenario remained RED because the workflow had no Flake Ledger integrity step.
tdd.green: The minimal append-only ledger, quarantine/closure operations, runner classification, committed policy record, and blocking CI integrity step made the focused suite pass 10/10 with 22 expect() calls.
tdd.refactor: Candidate detection, quarantine, closure, serialization, validation, and append-only reconciliation remain pure. The CLI only reads observations or appends new records; it never rewrites the ledger.

acceptance.criterion: A test case yielding differing verdicts across runs at the same commit is appended with its verdicts and run ids
acceptance.evidence: detectFlake requires one testFile/testName/commit, at least two distinct run ids, and both passed and failed verdicts. quarantineFlake appends a FlakeRecord carrying testFile, testName, commit, verdicts, runIds, and the underlying observations. Equal verdicts or different commits produce no candidate.

acceptance.criterion: Quarantining a flake requires a named owner and never removes the test file; closing an entry requires a named cause
acceptance.evidence: Blank owners are refused, and quarantine verifies the test path exists before append. Open records are immutable and status open; closeFlake refuses blank causes and appends a closure record. CI fails if an open record's test file disappears and does not skip or retry tests.

acceptance.criterion: Probe-generated contention is distinguished from runner slowness by the runner fingerprint recorded with each observation
acceptance.evidence: Every observation's declared fp-* value is recomputed from the task-16 RunnerComponents and rejected on mismatch. Each stored observation is classified as probe-generated-contention only when the concurrency probe executed and observed contention; otherwise it is named runner-slowness.

verification.proportional: PASS - 58 tests, 0 failures, 307 expect() calls across flake ledger, benchmark/fingerprint policy, and CI topology
verification.ledgerGate: PASS - one policy record, zero open flakes

decisions: The committed ledger begins with policy only. Historical flakes are documented but lack a specification-authorized named owner and exact paired run identity, so this task does not fabricate FlakeRecords for them.
An open flake is credibility debt, not permission to turn a failed test into pass. The integrity gate blocks malformed debt records while the unchanged test suite remains authoritative.
Observations are accepted by the CLI as a runner-produced JSON collection. Task 23 owns Suite Verdict composition and cross-run evidence publication; it was not started.
Project-memory updated the digest command/status only. No ADR/feature node was created, so docs/.graph.json and docs/README.md require no task-22 topology change.

scopeNotes.task23: No Suite Verdict producer, artifact publication, or quality-gate composition was added.
scopeNotes.preservedPriorWork: All prior dirty workflow, probe, ledger, documentation, and report changes were preserved.
